pages.title: Narmada Horse
pages.text: The Narmada horse ($(o)Equus namadicus$()) is an extinct horse that lived across the Indian subcontinent during the Middle and Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It is named after the Narmada River valley of central India, where its fossils have been found since the 19th century.$(br2)One of the largest species of $(o)Equus$(), it is thought to have been more closely related to zebras and asses than to true horses.
